entry: Next exchange session after a verified reverse split, at the open; action public before entry. Skip observed SSR rather than delay. Unknown status fails the executable gate.
exit: Same session close. Record partial fills, recalls and delayed exits; keep liabilities until a sourced cover and broker loan return. No assumed stop fill.
approval: Require dated security identity, margin schedule, written thesis, entry quote, approved locate reference, quantity and quoted annual fee. Public inventory is an indication only.
costs: One minimum borrowing day on rounded collateral; replace assumptions with dated broker fees when supplied. Entry spread, slippage and commission plus an equal exit-cost estimate must total no more than 1% of notional. Record actual fees and covers afterward.
controls: Up to three different issuers with score >=60, score difference <=15, same current SIC division, prior nominal price within factor 2 and prior 20-session dollar volume within factor 3. Exclude known reverse-split dates within 30 calendar days. Sort by pre-entry distance then ticker. Matching never uses future returns.
review: First review after at least 100 completed events and 60 issuers, with complete cost/exit records; descriptive interim updates only. Rules change only in a new version/cohort. This threshold is a review gate, not proof of representativeness.
